facts.subject: Term B
facts.gap_reason: No filing states a Term B balance at 2025-09-30. The Q3 10-Q gives only the aggregate term loan outstanding ($1,334 million). Exhibit 10.1 (Schedule I) prints $320,000,000.00 of Term B Commitments on 2025-09-18, when the existing Term B Loans were refinanced and replaced in their entirety; the 10-Q (Note 4) says the Term B Loans are not subject to amortization. That $320,000,000 is a 2025-09-18 commitment/refinanced amount, not a 2025-09-30 balance.

not_golden.why: Covered by financial_gold (Codex reviewed history incl. original-versus-revised values); this file adds only the restatement narrative as CP-1 text facts.
Judgment module: forecast and model drivers are analyst choices, not filing facts.
Judgment module: credit assessment and risk synthesis.
Judgment module: portfolio recommendation; also depends on user-supplied holdings, NAV and limits.
Relative-value quotes are user input; the filings carry no market quotes or price talk. Only the fair value of debt (a filing disclosure, not a quote) is recorded under CP-2.
User input: needs a prior decision record (attachments.prior_case); none exists for this issuer.

needs_user_input.why: CP-8 requires a prior decision record; none is available, so the flag stays false.
Portfolio holdings, NAV and limits are user-supplied; the flag stays false.

Observed quotes or price talk (bid, ask, price, yield, spread, date, provider) are third-party or user data absent from filings; the Q3 10-Q gives only a Level 2 fair value of long-term debt ($3,072 million).
Share price, market cap and EV are market data not in the filings (the Q3 10-Q cover gives only 73,904,136 shares at 2025-10-31); valuation basis stays at the form default auto.
Agency ratings are not in the three cited sources; left empty rather than recalled from memory.
Pinned assumptions are optional user choices; all stay null so the model chooses and labels them.

limitations: Only the Q3 2025 10-Q, the FY2024 10-K/A and Exhibit 10.1 (as extracted from the corpus HTML) were used; Q1/Q2 2025 and Q3 2024 10-Qs were not mined for module facts.
The original FY2024 10-K (filed 2025-03-03) is not in the corpus; as-reported amounts appear only through Note 18 of the 10-K/A.

The Exhibit 10.1 conformed text shows deleted and added text without markup in the extracted text; pricing and maturity quotes were chosen where the post-amendment clause is self-identifying (e.g. clause (a)(iii) of Applicable Rate, the Maturity Date definition).
Per-tranche outstanding balances, the applicable pricing level, the achieved leverage ratio and covenant compliance at 2025-09-30 are not stated in the sources and are recorded as missing.
Exhibit 10.1 does not print the revolver commitment (Schedule 2.01 is not in the text); the 600 comes from the Q3 10-Q.
Amounts are as printed: USD millions in the 10-Q and 10-K/A, exact USD in Exhibit 10.1 (scale units). Derived values are computed by derive.py in exact Decimal.
Sector and the Q3 revision of 2024 comparatives are summarised, not quantified, to avoid duplicating financial_gold.

2,912 is the company's own "our debt totaled" figure (10-Q MD&A): principal of funded borrowings, excluding finance leases. Codex's financial_gold marks total_debt FY2025Q3 missing because finance-lease liabilities are not located; its funded_borrowing_carrying_ex_finance_lease (2,869) matches this golden's derived carrying amount, so the two do not contradict.

The Subsidiary Guarantor names are the Loan Parties (other than the Company) that signed the 2025-09-18 Refinancing Facility Agreement; the source does not show whether that list is complete. Loan Party status of the seven is inferred from Section 9 ("Reaffirming Loan Parties"), the parties clause, and their being the only signatories other than the Company, the Administrative Agent and the Lenders.
identity.sector is set from the filing's own description of the business (CP-0 identity business_description), not a classification label.
